relations.note: the same book as Saturday week, and the one after

story.body: You read the roll, found no new mark, and went on. You called the afternoon the third, and you left Saturday as the fourth if the bill holds.

title: Went on as Chorus and Prince, the third time

participation.context: Said his hand was not needed, and refused to invent a cloak tonight.

story.body: You heard that he finished her without a hand under him. You forbade an experiment tomorrow and a higher note in a smaller room. You called Saturday the fourth and left it unspent. You left tomorrow's cloak unchosen.
